summary: Phase 18 - GREENIQ (Sustainability) + Student Assistant escalation tested end-to-end. 11/11 backend pytest cases pass on /app/backend/tests/test_phase18_greeniq.py (energy emission factors, water, carbon scope validation, ESG composite/grade, role-gating, cross-tenant 403, all-12-modules-active registry regression). Frontend GREENIQ cockpit (4 KPIs, ESG panel with 5 dimension bars + B+ grade badge, 3 tabs) renders correctly; energy + water + carbon submissions all succeed via UI with toast 'Emission recorded' and list updates. Student Assistant escalation: 'Didn't help? Escalate to ticket' button renders on each assistant reply, opens prefilled dialog (subject=original Q, body=Original/Assistant/Why blocks), creates ticket with open badge in tickets-list, persists after page refresh.

issues: DialogContent missing aria-describedby (Radix Dialog warning logged in console - accessibility lint, non-blocking)

React hydration warning: native <select> renders dynamic <option> children with extra <span> wrappers from instrumentation - benign but pollutes console with 'In HTML, <span> cannot be a child of <option>' error. Suggest using radix Select like other modules, or strip dynamic option wrappers.

critical_code_review_comments: ESG composite computation in routes_greeniq.py uses static base offsets (e_dim = renewable_pct + 50, w_dim = recycled_pct + 30, s_dim = 40 + mentorships*6) that bias scores upward independent of true sustainability. Acceptable as MVP placeholder; production should plumb in normalised KPIs vs targets.
Carbon scope is validated server-side (Pydantic ge=1, le=3) returning 422, but client-side <select> in GreenIQ.jsx only offers 1/2/3 so user can never pick out-of-range. OK by design.

GREENIQ writer guard checks role in (super_admin, institution_admin, facilities_admin, sustainability_admin, registrar). Student/faculty correctly blocked with 403. ESG GET is open to all tenant members (verified student 200).

ESG energy_trend only returns last 6 sorted periods; works but lexical sort assumes 'YYYY-MM' / 'YYYY-Www' format - mixing formats can mis-order. Acceptable since field is free-text and current usage is consistent.

Module catalog now lists all 12 platforms with default_status='active'; new tenants automatically get every platform on. The dependency check on PATCH (cannot activate if dep is not active) still works correctly.
test_credentials: principal@vaagdevi.edu.in / Demo@2026 (institution_admin), manikanta.cse@vaagdevi.edu.in / Demo@2026 (student for 403 probes + escalation flow). ISB cross-tenant probed by POSTing to ISB tenant id with VCE principal token -> 403 on energy/water/carbon.
seed_data_creation: GREENIQ: 3 energy rows (M-BL1 grid 12000 kWh 2026-02 -> 9.84 tCO2e, M-SOLAR solar 4500 kWh 2026-02 -> 0.18 tCO2e, M-OLD grid 1000 kWh 2026-01, plus M-TEST solar 2000 kWh 2026-03 -> 0.08 tCO2e from UI). 1 water row (W-BORE-01 borewell 250kL + W-TEST recycled 100kL from UI). 3 carbon rows (Diesel generator scope1 3.5 tCO2e x2 + Purchased electricity scope1 1.2 from UI). 1 support ticket from student assistant escalation (subject='How do I get my migration certificate?').
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 12 platforms are now active by default for new tenants. GREENIQ testids confirmed: sidebar-nav-greeniq (CAMPUS OPERATIONS group, Leaf icon), greeniq-page, greeniq-kpi-{composite,grade,renew,carbon}, greeniq-esg-{panel,grade}, greeniq-tab-{energy,water,carbon}, greeniq-en-{new,meter,loc,kwh,source,period,submit,list}, greeniq-wa-{new,source,loc,kl,type,period,submit,list}, greeniq-co-{new,scope,activity,tco2e,period,submit,list}. GreenIQ uses native HTML <select> (not Radix) for source/type/scope dropdowns - use page.select_option(testid, value) instead of clicking options. Student Assistant escalate testid pattern: assistant-escalate-{idx} where idx is the message index in the conversation array. Ticket dialog reuses existing ticket-{subject,body,category,severity,submit} testids - escalate() in StudentAssistant.jsx prefills draft and opens setOpen(true) automatically.
rca of the issue: No functional bugs. Two cosmetic React/Radix warnings: (a) DialogContent missing aria-describedby - add <DialogDescription> in GreenIQ dialogs; (b) native <select> options receive runtime span wrappers from the build instrumentation causing hydration warnings - switch to shadcn Select component to silence. Both are non-blocking and tests passed regardless.
